title: Consciousness is causally reducible but not ontologically reducible

statements.text: Consciousness is causally reducible to neuronal processes, since they cause it and its causal powers come from them. It is not ontologically reducible, because describing it as nothing but those processes in third-person terms would leave out its subjectivity.

sources.quote: I said that consciousness was causally reducible, but not ontologically reducible, to neuronal processes.
